name: Dynamic E - Injection shutdown (illustrative)
description: Methanol has been injecting long enough to reach steady concentration along the whole flowline. Close CIV-301: injection stops at the tree, but the methanol already in the flowline keeps moving to the manifold with the production flow. All data ILLUSTRATIVE.
briefing: Close CIV-301 and watch FT-301 drop to zero.
AT-510 falls quickly, AT-511 about an hour later, AT-512 later still - the methanol-free fluid front travels down the line.
Close PWV-101 as well: with no production flow the remaining methanol stops where it is.
